sloka: स चिन्तयित्वा सुचिरं धैर्यमालम्ब्य रावणः ।राघवं हरियूथांश्च ददर्शायतलोचनः ।। ६.४२.५ ।।।।
transliteration: sa cintayitvā suciraṁ dhairyamālambya rāvaṇaḥ ।rāghavaṁ hariyūthāṁśca dadarśāyatalocanaḥ ।। 6.42.5 ।।।।

translations.english: Ravana, thinking over for long, picking up courage, saw Rama's Vanaras with thoughtful eyes.
